About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

author: Ubisoft
description:
In November 2025, we invited 13 Keepers of the Code and community content creators to Singapore for an exclusive first look at our plans for Year 3.

Over three days, they connected directly with the development team, sharing open, thoughtful feedback not only on what’s coming next, but on the journey, we’ve taken together over the past two years since launch. These conversations went beyond features and roadmaps, reflecting on what’s working, what needs to evolve, and how we continue building the game side by side with our community.

Shaping the Future of Naval Combat Together is our way of reaffirming what sits at the heart of the experience: naval combat, mastery at the helm, and the commitment to build that future alongside the players who know it best.
